I recently explored a highly valuable PDF that stands out as one of the most comprehensive collections of Data Engineering questions and concepts available.
Whether you are preparing for interviews, transitioning to a new role, or simply reinforcing your foundational knowledge, this guide offers substantial value.
Key highlights from the document include:
• Interview-focused questions covering SQL, Python, Spark, and PySpark
• Real-world case scenarios involving Azure Data Factory (ADF), Databricks, and Synapse Analytics
• Concise cheat sheets and practical code snippets for quick reference
• Suitable for both aspiring and experienced data engineering professionals
If you’re working in or moving toward the data engineering space, this resource is definitely worth reviewing.
